title: Meat Cooking Temperatures
ingredients: Done/Medium Rare Out of Oven/Pan Final Temperature Resting Period
directions: When sautéing, turn the meat over every 1 minute or so – dividing the time into at least 4 segments, two for each side. In the last segment, you can baste with a little butter and herbs and/or garlic cloves. Bone-in takes a little longer than boneless. And, obviously, the thickness is a critical variable.

The required time for the pasteurization of poultry meat at 155°F is only one minute, or 165°F for 15 seconds. So if you are confident you’ve kept your bird in at least 155°F for a full minute than you should be safe (even if you see some red at the joints).
